date_note: Date of the abnormal access attempt as stated by ETNews; the article was published 25 November (KST).
title: Korea Information & Communications (KICC) VAN reportedly hit by abnormal access that exposed some merchant data, ETNews says
summary: ETNews, citing industry sources, reports that VAN provider Korea Information & Communications (KICC) was accessed by an abnormal user on 20 November and that some merchant information was leaked. ETNews says the attacker's IP address was then blocked. The exposed data includes business name, registration number, representative's name, address, MID, transaction numbers and affiliated simple-payment transaction history. The article says this follows a breach at payment gateway (PG) companies.
plain: ETNews reports, citing industry sources, that a Korean payment network provider was accessed by an abnormal user on 20 November and some merchant data leaked. KICC is not quoted in the article.
exec: A Korean VAN payment provider reportedly leaked some merchant data; ETNews warns it could be misused to set up fake settlement accounts.

validation.note: Only ETNews (citing industry sources) read; no KICC notice or regulator page read.
